notes: P03 baseline fidelity adapters for DSN 2027 (Recoverable Safety Journals for Crash-Consistent AI-Mediated Health-State Mutations). evaluation/venue2027/dsn/baselines.py implements run_baseline(baseline_id, case, ctx) -> Outcome (harness Outcome: observed_outcome in ADMIT/REJECT/INDETERMINATE/NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL, retriable flag) plus BASELINE_REGISTRY (typed BaselineSpec rows: provenance, registry name, runnability, notes) and refuse_constant_stub, over SYNTHETIC crash-window cases ({case_id, operation_id, crash_point, delivery_schedule, consent_epoch}; deterministic logical time, no hidden clock, no randomness, no network, no live provider, no real PHI/PII; injected BaselineContext.store dict as the in-process durable store, fresh per case so arms never share state). Arms: B0-single-write (bare durable write + fire-and-forget side effect, no journal — crash before the write loses the operation, crash after the commit orphans the side effect and a blind retry re-applies it: duplicate); B1-outbox-idempotent (row + transactional outbox + idempotency key in one durable transaction; retries and duplicate deliveries dedup on the key and re-ack without re-applying); B3-fsync (per-channel fsync discipline without an atomic multi-channel commit — the acknowledged-row/side-effect-pre-WAL window still loses the side effect and the arm reports it honestly as a lost side effect, never a phantom success); B4-candidate-journal (write-ahead journal entry durable BEFORE any channel write; recovery replays the journal and dedups by immutable operation id = exactly-once across the crash window); B5-monotonic-journal (B4 plus a monotonic sequence watermark; recovery rejects stale journal entries behind the watermark, non-retriably). Pinned external arm B2-durable-workflow (durable workflow/saga engine, registry ORIGINAL_UPSTREAM row durable-workflow-saga) is NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL with BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE: the pinned engine version and its parity fixture are absent from this worktree, so no toy substitution under the pinned name (EXECUTION_CONTRACT rule 8). Fail-closed contract: malformed cases/contexts and unknown baseline ids raise BaselineError with stable reason codes (wiring errors, never silently counted outcomes); crash-before-WAL yields REJECT + retriable + counted_as_success=False on every in-process arm (never a phantom success); extra case keys (including reason_code-like leak attempts) are refused. Core P03 separation asserted in tests: after the post-commit crash window, B4 recovery replay dedups to exactly-once (RC_JOURNAL_REPLAY_DEDUP) while B0's blind retry re-applies the orphaned write (duplicate) and B3 reports the lost side effect. refuse_constant_stub replays paired clean/crashed probe cases differing only in crash point and refuses a candidate whose (outcome, reason) signature is identical across the pair (CONSTANT_STUB_REFUSED) while admitting a crash-sensitive adapter (STUB_SEPARATION_OK). Machine-checked: 31 new tests pass (positive: registry coverage, clean-run commit per arm, B1 idempotent-consumer replay dedup, B4-vs-B0/B3 exactly-once contrast, B4 pre-outbox-crash replay dedup, B5 stale-entry guard, determinism; adversarial: crash-before-WAL never counted as success on any arm, constant-stub refusal, crash-sensitive admission, NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL arm, unknown baseline id / non-mapping case / missing-unknown-badly-typed fields / malformed context wiring errors); full evaluation/venue2027/dsn suite 113 passed; ruff@0.7.1 check clean on touched files. source_sha_after = base SHA per established repo convention (proof report committed together with the work).
